judge.rationale: The candidate completely failed to modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`, meaning the actual bug fix was never implemented. Instead, it only added failing acceptance tests (one of which explicitly contains the comment `// This should FAIL now because onError is gated by instanceof Error`) along with the spec and changelog updates. Additionally, the new test file lacks the required eslint-disable comment on the non-yielding generator `sendMessage`, which will fail `npm run eslint --max-warnings 0`. While the documentation updates in `CHANGELOG.md` and `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` are on the right track, leaving the production code untouched leaves the test suite broken and the primary acceptance criteria unmet.
